premises.text: Clients expect personalized portfolios and advice but get generic mutual-fund/ETF buckets because advisors lack time and tools

premises.text: Advisor–client trusted relationships are irreplaceable by tools and must remain the focus
premises.evidence_span: They've built lasting and trusted relationships with their clients

premises.text: AI builds personalized portfolios of stocks, bonds, and other assets around client goals, values, and constraints

premises.text: Portfolio intelligence generates the story and justifications advisors need to explain decisions to clients

premises.text: Platform automates management and rebalancing so advisors spend time on relationships

premises.text: Advanced quant models coupled with ML, plus proprietary NLG, drive personalization and explanations
